people.name: Balaam
people.line: A prophet hired to curse Israel but blessed them instead.

people.name: Evi
people.line: Midianite king killed in battle against Israel.

people.name: Hur
people.line: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites.

people.name: Midian
people.line: A nation descended from Abraham; oppressed Israel in the time of the judges

people.name: Reba
people.line: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites

people.name: Rekem
people.line: A Midianite king killed by the Israelites

translations.web: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.
translations.bsb: Among the slain were Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba—the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam son of Beor with the sword.
translations.kjv: And they slew the kings of Midian, beside the rest of them that were slain; namely, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
translations.asv: And they slew the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian: Balaam also the son of Beor they slew with the sword.
